title: 波士顿动力创始人：人形机器人五年后能做什么？仓库工厂先行，家庭尚远
speaker: Marc Raibert

segments.en: And I think if we focused on that, with a variety of morphologies involved, morphologies means two legs, two arms and a head or wheels and some other kind of body or maybe six arms, there's really no limit to what could be versatile and useful like a human.
segments.zh: 我认为如果我们专注于这一点，并涉及多种形态——形态意味着两条腿、两条手臂和一个头，或者轮子和另一种身体，或者六条手臂——那么像人类一样多才多艺和有用的可能性真的没有极限。

segments.en: So having said that, Mark, I'm wondering what's hype, what's not, five years down the road, what might these humanoid robots, whether you like the term or not, what would they be able to do?
segments.zh: 话虽如此，马克，我想知道哪些是炒作，哪些不是。五年后，这些你喜不喜欢这个称呼都罢的人形机器人，能做什么？

segments.en: It's hard to predict. I think that the easy thing to say is robots of various shapes and forms are already being used in warehouses and places like that, very organized things where there's objects being handled at very high volume.
segments.zh: 很难预测。容易说的是，各种形状和形式的机器人已经在仓库等场所使用，那些地方非常有序，物体处理量很大。

segments.en: And where it's hard to get human labor, human labor has a lot of turnover, there's aging populations, reduced populations, a lot of the attitudes towards some kinds of work is changing among young people, some populations are aging out for skilled labor.
segments.zh: 在难以获得人力劳动的地方，人力流动率高，人口老龄化，人口减少，年轻人对某些工作的态度在改变，一些群体的熟练劳动力正在老化退出。

segments.en: So there's a lot of pieces to the puzzle of what robots are going to be able to do.
segments.zh: 所以机器人能做什么这个谜题有很多拼图。

segments.en: Anyway, I start to say, I think warehouses are now factories are probably next, I think our homes are going to be a little ways out because for homes you need a lot of safety, you need really ultimate safety, you need low cost for consumers to be able to buy them and you need them to be able to do something useful in the home.
segments.zh: 总之，我开始说，我认为仓库之后，工厂可能是下一个，家庭则要远一些，因为家庭需要大量安全保障，需要极致安全，需要低成本让消费者买得起，还需要它们能在家里做有用的事。

segments.en: And given that everybody's house is different, everybody's junk is different, everybody's kids are there and vulnerable, it's a real challenge.
segments.zh: 考虑到每个人的房子不同，杂物不同，孩子在场且脆弱，这确实是真正的挑战。
